changelog: Orion 3.8 — the whole app has a new look: every screen rebuilt on the Midnight Stage design (dark stage, gold accents, one clear action per screen, plain words everywhere). New: the Command Center. At the top is Casey's word — his current focus and standing order. Then the live Swan Bridge board, one card for every agent on the bridge (however many there are), Lessons from your teachers, What Orion picked up, and the full Library: all 129 of Casey's spaces in 8 sections that open and close. Orion's API is simply ON now — the old not-connected wording and the CHECK AGAIN button are gone. Everything starts by itself when the app opens: Orion's API, the web computer, the terminal, voice, memory, self-learning, and the Command Center each prove themselves in a startup check — and after a phone restart they come back on their own. The microphone still needs your one tap after a restart; that is Android's rule, and Orion posts a tap-to-resume note for it. The generator got its overhaul: real game kinds (monster RPG, snake, breakout, racer, memory), real tools, menus, and trackers — and when Orion cannot build something honestly, he says so and builds nothing. Orion carries the full knowledge pack now, learns from his own work (failures become lessons, and lessons are read before he acts), and learns from the board: new TEACH ORION lessons and finished agent work land in his memory from the Command Center. The change-avatar option is always on Persona & Style, and the graphics switch there is yours. One honest gap, stated plain: the trained Hey Orion wake-word model is not in this build yet — the Voice page says wake listening is off instead of pretending. New Terms section 6Z covers the wake engine, the generator, your data cloud, graphics, the Command Center, learning, and restarts — the app will ask you to agree again, once.
